chunks: 2104 - Ibn al-Mughīrah narrated from Samā‘ah, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a person in iʿtikāf who had intercourse with his spouse, so he said: “He is in the position of one who broke the fast on a day of the month of Ramaḍān.”

key_terms.أَهْلَهُ: his spouse or family, here meaning his wife
key_terms.بِمَنْزِلَةِ: in the same legal status or position as
key_terms.شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ: the month of Ramaḍān, whose fast carries major legal sanctity
key_terms.مُعْتَكِفٍ: a person observing iʿtikāf, spiritual retreat in the mosque

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on a person in iʿtikāf who has intercourse with their spouse?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning one in iʿtikāf who engages in sexual relations with a spouse. The Imam عليه السلام equates it with breaking a fast in Ramaḍān, indicating the gravity of the violation and its juridical consequence.
